## Session Summary

## Work Performed

### Phases Touched
- **Phase 1 — Member Sign-In & Sessions** — finished the sign-in throttling, the router guard with its bare sign-in frame, and the forced new-password screen; Phase 1 closed at the end of the session.
- **Phase 2 — Roles & Permissions** — read only: its success criteria were checked against the session identity Phase 1 now provides. No files changed.

### Key Outcomes
- Sign-in attempts are throttled on two self-clearing counters, one per account name and one per address.
- A wrong account name and a wrong password now return the same answer and take the same time to return it.
- The router guard sends a signed-out visitor to `/sign-in` and a member holding a temporary password to `/set-password`.
- The `/sign-in` screen renders in a bare frame with no shed navigation.
- The top bar shows the member's name with a sign-out button.
- The kiosk passcode check is gone from every route.
- The full test suite passes, including the new same-answer proof.

### Decisions Made
- Throttle counters live in the same SQLite file as the sessions, so they survive a restart without a second store.
- The sign-in screen links nowhere: account creation stays with stewards through `lendctl`.

- `test/server/` — the throttle and same-answer proofs
